Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
Tortured Confession
1 blood
Only usable when the opposing vampire goes into torpor; not usable by a
vampire going into torpor. Combat ends. You may look at the opposing
vampire's controller's hand.

Nice card! Not sure about the "combat ends" part... Combat was supposed to
end anyway... What impact does this text hav? Does the opposing vampire now
NOT go to torpor?

Chas Giovanni Tello
DOM POT
Independent : When Chas announces an action, any other Methuselah can
discard a master card as an out-of-turn master to cause the action to fail.
Chas gets +1 strength when in combat with a titled vampire.

Guess I have to find a way to use this baby without taking actions... Lots
of deflections, some permanent intercept spiced up with signposts, grapples
and big POT-strikes! In any case, he'll be difficult to play, but fun too!
Weaknesses are advantages you have to search a little harder to find!

/Henke

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From "Henke" <d98...@stud.hh.se> =====

>Tortured Confession
>1 blood
>Only usable when the opposing vampire goes into torpor; not usable by a
>vampire going into torpor. Combat ends. You may look at the opposing
>vampire's controller's hand.
>
>Nice card! Not sure about the "combat ends" part... Combat was supposed to
>end anyway... What impact does this text hav? Does the opposing vampire now
>NOT go to torpor?

It ends combat. It doesn't save the opposing vampire from torpor (since
nothing on card text indicates that it does). It would, for example,
prevent you from Torturing your victim and then Amaranthing him.
(Something that would be possible if Tortured Confession didn't explicitly
end combat as part of its effect).
